resources.string: Inkontileka eshicilelwe: lokho i-plugin engakusho, nokuthi yini eyamukelwe noma enqatshiwe lapha.

Amandla amenyezelwe ukufunda noma isiphakamiso. Awekho ngamabomu amandla okubhala ihadiwe: konke okulotshwe kulolu hlelo lokusebenza kudlula ku-arbiter, futhi i-plugin engabhala ngokuqondile izosusa unogada owakhelwe ukumisa abanikazi ababili ababhala ifindo elifanayo.
Lo mbhalo yilokho okufundwa ngumhlaziyi. Ayikwazi ukukhukhuleka kusuka kukhodi, ngoba ikhiqizwa kuyo.
Ifaka kuhlu ifolda ye-manifest enempande, bese ihlola i-manifest ngayinye ngokumelene nenkontileka.
Ifolda ye-manifest ayinawo amafolda e-plugin. Akukho okungalungile: lesi isimo esizenzakalelayo sesici.
%1$s ayikadalwa kule divayisi, ngakho-ke akukho okungafundwa. Ukuyidala yikho konke umlobi we-plugin okudingeka akwenze.
Ifolda ikhona kokuthi %1$s kodwa igobolondo alikwazanga ukuyifunda. Kudingeka impande ukuze uyifake ohlwini.
I-id ayisebenzi njengegama lefolda. Sebenzisa izinhlamvu zesiLatini ezincane, amadijithi, amachashazi, amadeshi noma ama-underscore, futhi ungalokothi ube namachashazi amabili ngokulandelana.
Ileveli ye-API emenyezelwe ayikho noma ingaphansi kuka-1.
Ileveli ye-API emenyezelwe yintsha kunalokho okuqondwa yilesi sakhiwo, ngakho ayisebenzi sanhlobo.
Amandla awayona ingxenye yale nkontileka. Ikhono elingaziwa liyenqatshwa kunokuba lishaywe indiva, ngakho-ke akukho lutho oluhamba ngamalungelo ambalwa kunalokho obuceliwe.
I-plugin kufanele iveze okungenani ikhono elilodwa.
Enye i-plugin enale ID yayisivele yamukelwe, ngakho lena ayisetshenziswa.

Ngaphandle kwenkontileka eshicilelwe, noma ubani owelula lolu hlelo lokusebenza kufanele aqagele umumo wamafayela ethu angaphakathi, futhi ngeke sikwazi ukusho isandiso esivumelekile kwesiphukile. Ngayo, umkhawulo ushiwo: i-plugin iveza inhloso futhi ifundeka; ayilokothi ibhale ihadiwe, futhi konke ukwenqaba okungenhla kuqamba inkambu eqondile ehlulekile.
